review_verdict.summary: The browser matrix is generated from the current Playwright run; static screenshots are retained only as historical visual context.

baseline_findings.finding: Unsafe native pickle archives could execute code.
baseline_findings.resolution: New saves use a versioned primitive-only NPZ schema; legacy pickle loading requires an explicit trusted-file opt-in.

baseline_findings.finding: Large valid browser workloads could exhaust memory or remain uninterruptible.
baseline_findings.resolution: The adapter rejects oversized sweeps and grids before allocation, and obsolete synchronous jobs terminate and recreate the worker.

baseline_findings.finding: Raw energies were mislabeled as normalized E/t₁.
baseline_findings.resolution: All spectral and surface labels now state the upstream raw energy E.

baseline_findings.finding: Published audit evidence could remain stale while displaying PASS.
baseline_findings.resolution: Physics, browser, and accessibility evidence carries a source-tree fingerprint; report generation refuses mismatched inputs and still renders failures.

baseline_findings.finding: Base Python installs broke CLI help when optional UI packages were absent.
baseline_findings.resolution: Argument parsing now precedes optional plotting imports, and actual CLI execution names the required cli extra.

baseline_findings.finding: Lattice CSV links used the wrong record stride.
baseline_findings.resolution: Link exports now use all six fields: endpoints, neighbor shell, and amplitude.

baseline_findings.finding: NPZ import accepted incomplete and non-finite physical data.
baseline_findings.resolution: The importer requires versioned state arrays and an exact topology flag, validates finite/order/range/gap consistency, and checks file size before reading.

baseline_findings.finding: A cancelled geometry request could leave band exports disabled.
baseline_findings.resolution: Geometry expectations clear when no longer requested, and export gating only waits for currently requested geometry.

baseline_findings.finding: All-zero generic hopping and extreme amplitudes reached NumPy failures.
baseline_findings.resolution: Browser and Python boundaries bound amplitudes and return a clear domain error for undefined all-zero generic models.

baseline_findings.finding: Shared URLs omitted the active analysis state.
baseline_findings.resolution: Color, palette, surface metric, geometry table, band, cut zoom, linked momentum, and butterfly transform now round-trip.
The Wilson plot exposes a focusable slider with arrow, page, Home, and End keyboard controls.

baseline_findings.finding: The Pages workflow granted broad permissions and trusted mutable action tags.
baseline_findings.resolution: Jobs now use least-privilege permissions, disable persisted checkout credentials, and pin every action to an exact commit.

limitations.reason: Automated semantics, keyboard interaction, contrast, reduced motion, and responsive browser behavior are covered; a separate screen-reader session was not run.
The source audit does not replace continuously refreshed npm and Python advisory scans.
